findings.description: Disabled users retaining a valid token and lease can create, accept, inspect, or travel a group, including moving the companion character.
Snapshot restore can race or follow group travel and mutate one member's authoritative zone without synchronizing the group, leaving durable inconsistent state.
Invitation expiry is checked before invitee ownership, allowing a foreign authenticated caller to distinguish known expired or consumed invitation identifiers from missing identifiers.
Oversized group request targets bypass the group no-store middleware and may produce cacheable errors.
